summary: Backend (Convex HTTP) tested: 9/9 passed + 1 OTP SMS error-path test consuming 1/5 quota. Frontend: login screen renders correctly with Arabic RTL, +963 default CC, WhatsApp UI absent as required. Session-token injection via localStorage works (AsyncStorage web backs onto window.localStorage with raw key `session_token`, JSON-encoded). Owner, Accountant, Developer dashboards all render with live Convex data. CRITICAL BUG: Field Agent (test_token_agent) is routed to /dist but no app/dist route exists -> 'Unmatched Route - Page could not be found'. Secondary: tab bar items in owner/acct/dev _layout.tsx have no testIDs (visible labels work but automated tab taps need testIDs). Minor: `expo-image` emits 'style.resizeMode is deprecated' warning.

minor.issue: For +963900000099 the SMS gateway rejects with HTTP 422 before SIM check, producing 'رقم الهاتف غير صالح أو غير مدعوم' instead of the SIM-missing message. Error is still Arabic and user-safe, but task note expected the SIM-missing branch - gateway only hits SIM-missing for numbers it considers deliverable.

ui_bugs.issue: Field Agent dashboard route does not exist. homeFor() in src/auth.tsx:152 returns 'dist' for FIELD_AGENT employees and _layout.tsx redirects to /dist, but there is no /app/frontend/app/dist/ directory. Users see Expo Router 'Unmatched Route'.

Tabs.Screen entries have no testID on tabBarButton / tabBarIcon. Expected testIDs like owner-tab-overview, acct-tab-sales, dev-tab-licenses are not present. Dashboards render fine but programmatic tab navigation isn't testable.

integration_issues.issue: Seeded test_token_agent authenticates (API /auth/me returns EMPLOYEE+FIELD_AGENT correctly) but the client has no destination screen, so the whole Field Agent experience is broken on all platforms (web + native).

issues: Looks correct: RTL layout, +963 default CC, phone input left-aligned LTR, Arabic terms text, hero image + gradient. No WhatsApp buttons.
Welcome tour modal auto-opens on first visit (expected). Tabs render as icons+Arabic labels. Live data from Convex (TEST مؤسسة الاختبار, 1 org, 4 users) displayed correctly.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' Likely from a <Image style={{ resizeMode: ... }}> usage. Move resizeMode out of style to a prop.

action_items: CRITICAL: Create /app/frontend/app/dist/ route group with _layout.tsx + index.tsx + visits.tsx + map.tsx (or whichever screens Field Agent needs). Alternatively change homeFor() to point to an existing route. Without this, field-agent accounts cannot use the app.

Add testID props on each Tabs.Screen in app/owner/_layout.tsx, app/acct/_layout.tsx, app/dev/_layout.tsx and the new app/dist/_layout.tsx (e.g. options={{ tabBarButtonTestID: 'owner-tab-overview' }}) so automated tests can tap tabs.
Fix expo-image style.resizeMode deprecation: pass resizeMode as a prop instead of style property wherever used.
critical_code_review_comments: src/auth.tsx homeFor() returns 'dist' for FIELD_AGENT but no such route exists -> hard dead-end. Route table and homeFor should be kept in sync, ideally via a shared const.
src/api.ts throws plain Error('حدث خطأ غير متوقع') when backend returns non-string detail; consider logging the actual response body in dev mode.

convex/edge.ts gateError maps 400/422 to 'رقم الهاتف غير صالح أو غير مدعوم'. If the gateway reports SIM-missing with HTTP 400+'No SIMs' in body, the /No SIMs/ check still runs before gateError thanks to the regex check - OK. But current prod gateway rejects any Syrian mobile prefix outside its allow-list, so SIM path is hard to exercise.
App has a 'tour' modal that auto-opens over every dashboard; make sure it has testID + close button testID so tests can dismiss it reliably.

success_rate.frontend: 75% (3/4 role dashboards work; field agent dashboard route missing)

seed_data_creation: None - used pre-seeded Convex accounts (test_token_dev/owner/acct/agent) created by edge:seedTestAccounts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To authenticate on web preview: await page.goto(login) then page.evaluate("localStorage.setItem('session_token', JSON.stringify('test_token_owner'))") then reload. AsyncStorage web uses window.localStorage with raw key and JSON-encoded value. Convex API base: https://fearless-ostrich-878.eu-west-1.convex.site/api. Do not spam /auth/otp/request (5/hour/phone, 30s cooldown). SMS gateway device has no SIM so real OTP cannot be delivered. All 4 seeded roles authenticate on /api/auth/me; only field agent lacks a destination route.
rca_of_issue: Field Agent 'Unmatched Route' bug: homeFor(user) in /app/frontend/src/auth.tsx line 152 returns the string 'dist' for EMPLOYEE+FIELD_AGENT users. Gate() in /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx then calls router.replace('/dist'). Expo Router looks for /app/frontend/app/dist/{index,_layout}.tsx but the directory doesn't exist (only acct, dev, owner, and loose screens are present). Expo Router falls back to its built-in +not-found page. Reproduction: set localStorage session_token='test_token_agent' and open the app on web; the URL becomes /dist and the 'Unmatched Route - Page could not be found' screen renders. Fix: either (a) create the dist route folder with the field-agent screens that the task description lists ('agent dist screens'), or (b) point homeFor to an existing route.
